entries.original: The Early Access release of Sentinels of the Multiverse 2 is fully playable and includes all hero, villain, and environment decks from the full core game. The full version is planned to have the following additional major features and content: - Interactive tutorial - Campaign mode - Online multiplayer - Villain Events and Critical Events - First Appearance Hero Variants - Improved music and sound effects - More extensive UI animations & interactions - How to Play & Card Library screens - Steam Achievements & Statistics We plan to roll out features and content in several updates during the Early Access phase. If you see a problem or have a suggestion, please report it when it occurs using the in-game Send Feedback button. Thanks for playing!

entries.original: Ally: A target of your type (Hero, Villain, Environment) other than yourself. Bury: Put the indicated card on the bottom of the associated deck. If that deck has zero cards in it, the card goes to trash instead. Collect: Search your deck for the indicated amount of the indicated cards and put them in your hand. Shuffle your deck. Discover: Reveal cards from the top of the deck until you reveal the indicated cards. Shuffle the other revealed cards into the deck. Play the cards in the order revealed. Reaction: When a Hero target would be dealt damage by a non-Hero target, it may activate any reaction text on cards already in play that give that Hero target a reaction. Like powers, each reaction can only be activated once per turn. Salvage: Search your trash for the indicated amount of the indicated cards and put them in your hand. Summon: Search the trash and/or deck for the indicated amount of the indicated cards. Play the cards found. If you searched the deck, shuffle it. For more explanation of terms, see pages 15-17 of the rulebook.
